description: Recursively enumerate `~/Documentos_Teste`, `~/Documentos`, `~/Downloads`, `~/Imagens`, and `/mnt` using `opendir` and `readdir`; capture files with the following extensions: `.xlsx`, `.docx`, `.pdf`, `.txt`, `.csv`, `.jpg`, `.png`, `.db`, `.backup`, `.psd`, `.zip`, and `.rar`; use only `libc`, `libssl/libcrypto`, and `libcurl` as external dependencies.
name: enumeracao_e_captura_de_arquivos
